headline:
MALDA DRUG NETWORK BUSTED
₹2.4 CRORE CASH SEIZED
THREE ACCUSED ARE ARRESTED

headlineLayout.qaCorrection: Changed NARCOTICS to DRUG after the first export wrapped line 1 into a fourth visible line.

caption:
A joint police operation in Malda, West Bengal, has reportedly busted a cross-border narcotics network. The operation led to the seizure of ₹2.4 crore in cash, thousands of cough syrup bottles valued at about ₹90 lakh, and 20 grams of gold.

Three accused have been arrested, according to the initial report. Authorities are expected to continue investigating the suspected network and the origin of the seized cash and goods.
